messages:
incident-bot: PagerDuty: page fired for service=redwood-inference-serving severity=high alert_key=inference-high-latency region=eu-west-1 — 3m avg p95 latency 1.8s, error rate 4%. Affected customers: 2 enterprise customers on dedicated pools. PagerDuty incident: PD-4219.

anna (oncall): acked — I'm on it. pinging infra and runtime. anyone seeing recent deploys? :white_check_mark:

raj: I didn't see deploys in the window, last deploy 00:10 UTC. Looks like a sudden spike in KV cache misses. metrics: kv_cache_hitratio dropped from 0.98 to 0.6.

tomas: can we confirm if this is global or only eu-west-1?

olivia: dashboards show region-local spike, eu-west-1 only. us-west and asia look fine.

anna (oncall): ok root cause hypothesis: cache eviction storm on sequence-length heavy requests from customer X. Will attempt quick mitigation: route traffic for those customers to eu-dedicated-fallback pool. Creating a rule now.

anna (oncall): applying routing override: `POST /routing/override` payload `{ "match": { "customer_id": ["cust-X"] }, "route": "eu-dedicated-fallback", "ttl": 300 }` — applying..

support-bot: Route change queued, will take effect in ~12s.

raj: also bumping KV cache size on the affected pool from 60GB -> 96GB to reduce thrashing. Doing graceful restart of runtime workers on nodes 12-15.

tomas: logging note: I see repeated logs showing `kv_cache::evict: victim=prefix-XXXX, cand_size=48MB` every 50ms. Likely a workload with many unique prefixes.

anna (oncall): onboarding customer success — @olivia please prepare a short customer-facing note if routing causes any changes.

olivia: drafting msg: "We're mitigating elevated latency by routing your requests to a dedicated fallback pool in eu-west-1; no data loss; you may see slightly different latency profile for ~10 minutes." Will post to the ticket once we have stabilization.

raj: runtime restarts done, cache size increased. p95 dropped from 1.8s -> 0.45s within two minutes. error rate back to 0.2%.

incident-bot: PD-4219 updated: acknowledged by anna, status=mitigating, responders=[anna,raj,tomas].

tomas: I'm going to keep a short-lived tracing capture for 5 minutes to verify prefix distribution. dropping a small sampling:```
sampled_prefixes:
- prefix-6a12
- prefix-77f9
- prefix-cc03
- prefix-a9b1
```

anna (oncall): looks stable. I'm handing this to raj for follow-up and root cause analysis. @raj please take ownership for postmortem. I'll remove the routing override after we confirm stable for 30m.

raj: taking ownership. Next steps: collect full KV eviction histograms, correlate with customer request patterns, and check client-side batching changes. I'll open PD follow-up and link to the postmortem.

support-bot: PD-4219 munged to ``resolved`` state in PagerDuty? Not yet, waiting on owner.

olivia: customer support ticket created and updated with message. Customer acknowledges and appreciates quick mitigation.

anna (oncall): final check: p95 steady 0.42s, errors <0.3%. I'm going to clear my oncall tag and mark handoff at 1765123720. Good job team. :tada:

raj: noted. I'll post a timeline and assign the RCA to myself. Closing the pager on my side after RCA doc created.

incident-bot: PD-4219 status changed to: monitoring.

anna (oncall): thanks all — short blameless retro scheduled tomorrow 09:00 for 30m to discuss improvements (cache sizing autoscale, routing safeguards).
